subject: Helix Therapeutics security discovery — network isolation & air-gap options
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Mason <tom.mason@helixthera.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 4 Jun 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + next steps (network isolation / air-gap options)

Tom — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we can move toward a Private/VPC evaluation: 

1) Compliance posture (what we need from you)
- Current SOC 2 status: Type (I/II), in-progress or completed; if in-progress, estimated completion date.
- Any HIPAA controls in-scope and GDPR data residency requirements.

2) Network & deployment topology
- Please share the high-level network sketch you referenced on the call (subnet/VPC boundaries, NAT/proxy, private peering, on-prem/firewall boundaries). A simple PNG/PDF is fine.
- Confirm whether an air-gapped on-prem option is on the roadmap or if you only expect VPC + private connectivity.

3) Vendor security questionnaire
- With your OK, we will start the Redwood Vendor RFI (attached) and send a compact questionnaire to your security/infra leads. Typical turnaround is 5–7 business days for initial answers.

4) Proposed owners & timeline
- Helix POC: Tom Mason (infra/security) and Aisha Patel (privacy).
- Redwood owners: Jordan (SE, deployment sizing), Neha (security/compliance).
- Proposed next milestone: delivery of network sketch + SOC 2 snapshot by EOD Tue (2027-06-08) so we can scope a Private pilot.

Attachments: Redwood_Vendor_RFI_20270604.docx (attached) — this is our standard short-form RFI to help focus answers for Private deployments.

If any of this is wrong or you'd like a different timeline, call it out and we'll adjust.

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0173

From: Tom Mason <tom.mason@helixthera.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aisha Patel <aisha.p@helixthera.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Jun 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + next steps (network isolation / air-gap options)

Thanks Rachel — appreciate the clear notes. A few clarifications from our side: 

- SOC 2 status: We are currently mid-Type II audit (in-progress) with an external auditor; expected completion and reporting is early Q4 2027. I attached a short snapshot of our current control coverage (Helix_SoC2_Status_Snapshot.pdf).
- HIPAA: We have certain PHI flows for a pilot subset; HIPAA BAAs would be required for production.
- GDPR: We route EU customer data to EU regions; no global data residency change is planned today.

Network sketch: attaching the high-level diagram I sketched after the call (Helix_Network_Sketch_20270601.png). It shows our primary VPC, an on-prem data center with a one-way data push, and an AWS Transit Gateway for partner peering. We do not currently plan a fully air-gapped environment, but an air-gap option is interesting for a small pilot if required.

Action items from us: I will confirm a Helix infra/security POC to complete Redwood's RFI and aim to return answers within 7 business days. Aisha is copied — she will coordinate the questionnaire response.

Tom
Tom Mason
Head of Infrastructure, Helix Therapeutics
tom.mason@helixthera.com

On Fri, Jun 4, 2027 at 2:05 PM Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai> wrote:
> (see below)
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Tom Mason <tom.mason@helixthera.com>, Aisha Patel <aisha.p@helixthera.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Post-call recap + next steps (network isolation / air-gap options) — please own RFI and initial security review

Neha — forwarding the Helix thread and their sketches. They are mid-SOC2 Type II (expected Q4), have some HIPAA scope, and route EU data to EU regions.

Can you take lead on the Redwood vendor RFI (attached) and do a quick gap scan vs our Private deployment checklist? Key asks: 
- Validate whether Helix's current topology supports Redwood Private without changes (VPN/peering, allowed egress, KV cache security).
- Call out blockers for an air-gapped on-prem pilot and estimate effort to support it.
- If helpful, we can request a short topology session with Tom and their infra SME next week.

I attached our short RFI (Redwood_Vendor_RFI_20270604.docx). If you prefer, I can pre-fill basic product/hosting answers before we send. Jordan — please standby for sizing questions after Neha's quick scan.

Thanks — Rachel

Attachments: Redwood_Vendor_RFI_20270604.docx
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Tom Mason <tom.mason@helixthera.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Aisha Patel <aisha.p@helixthera.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Post-call recap + next steps (network isolation / air-gap options) — next actions

Thanks Rachel / Tom. I reviewed the materials Rachel forwarded and sketched a short plan: 

1) Immediate: I'll triage the Redwood RFI and pre-fill product/hosting answers by EOD Tue (2027-06-08). Tom/Aisha — can you confirm a technical POC (name + email) who can answer questions around Transit Gateway peering and egress rules? That will speed the topology validation.

2) Evidence request: Alongside the diagram Tom provided, please send any firewall/NAT boundary notes or a short list of public endpoints that will need to be allowed. If sharing internal diagrams, we can accept a redacted PNG.

3) Air-gap feasibility: Initial read — based on the sketch, a fully air-gapped install would require an on-premizable package (we have one but it adds SOW/time). I will enumerate the exact blockers (storage, update channels, audit log collection) in the RFI response.

4) Timeline & deliverables:
- RFI answers (initial pass) — 2027-06-08
- Topology validation readout (internal) — 2027-06-11
- If agreeable, 30-min topology call (Tom + Helix infra SME + Jordan + me) — propose Wed 2027-06-09 10:00 AM PT.

HubSpot ticket created: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/HLX-2027-042 (I will attach the RFI and diagrams there).

Neha Kapoor
Principal Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
